notes.title: BALL x PIT is Steam Deck Verified
notes.content:
[p]Hello, fellow treasure seekers![/p][p]
We’ve got some cool news to share: BALL x PIT will be Steam Deck Verified at launch on October 15![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649613/21d07660584ab8744ecb1da7a39a0a71b7f501d6.png"][/img][/p][p]That means the game runs smoothly, looks great, and fully supports the Steam Deck’s built-in controls and screen. So yes, you can now take the balls anywhere. And we really hope you do.[/p][p][/p][p]More baller updates are on the way, so stay tuned.[/p][p]
Also, we’re almost there - less than 3 weeks to go![/p][p]
Talk soon![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Treasure Seeker Sneak Peek: 🛡️The Shieldbearer🛡️
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, ye Treasure Seekers![/p][p]
With less than two months to go before the release of BALL x PIT, we wanted to share a bit more about one of the many characters you'll encounter in this adventure.[/p][p]
In your deep dive into the ominous crater that was once Ballbylon, you’ll choose from over a dozen playable characters. Some are fast, some are smart, some are just plain chaotic — but only one Treasure Seeker can capitalize off of the boldest reflexes![/p][p]
The front line’s first defense: [b]The Shieldbearer[/b].[/p][p]A stoic warrior forged in the Iron Fortress. One who shoots and bounces balls back towards the enemy. Get an exclusive sneak peek at one of the boldest among all the Treasure Seekers.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="H6hPDZ6sqkw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]BALL x PIT[/i] launches October 15![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/BALLxPIT"]Join our Discord server[/url] to share the wait with fellow adventurers and ball enthusiasts. Follow us on [url="https://x.com/BALLxPIT"]X[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/ballxpit.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/BALLxPIT/"]Reddit[/url] for the latest baller news.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Smash everything with your balls in BALL x PIT releasing October 15
notes.content:
Do you have the balls to go deep into a bottomless pit? Well, you'll find out on October 15 when fast-paced fantasy roguelite BALL x PIT releases.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/smash-everything-with-your-balls-in-ball-x-pit-releasing-october-15/

notes.title: BALL x PIT launches on October 15
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649613/6ded4c7f877242b2efc6672f2546da593d57f91e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The wait is over! We’re so excited to finally confirm that [b][i]BALL x PIT[/i][/b] launches [b]October 15![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and the amazing support you’ve shown us since the reveal back in June. We can’t wait for you all to play the full game![/p][p][/p][p]Remember: [b]all your demo progress will carry over to the full release[/b], so keep playing until then! And if you haven’t wishlisted [i]BALL x PIT[/i] yet, we’d really appreciate it, it helps us out a lot![/p][p][/p][p]Check out the fresh new gameplay trailer:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="GB5v8BAn97Q;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/BALLxPIT"]Discord server[/url] and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/BALLxPIT/"]Reddit[/url] to share the wait with us and other ball enthusiasts and follow our socials on [url="https://x.com/BALLxPIT"]X[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/ballxpit.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@ballxpit"]TikTok[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]We hope to see you all ballin’ on October 15! <3[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Thank you for playing BALL x PIT!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, treasure seekers!

What an amazing week it’s been! Never in our wildest dreams did we imagine the incredible support we've seen from all of you.

Since [url="https://youtu.be/AFDugjeJK5g?feature=shared"]BALL x PIT revealed at Summer Game Fest[/url], over [b]165,000 players[/b] have jumped into the demo! But it gets even better: the demo is now sitting at an amazing 96% positive rating, with more than 700 reviews on Steam, and we have already gathered over [b]116,000 wishlists[/b]! From the pit of our hearts, THANK YOU to everyone who played, shared their thoughts, and showed so much love for our little game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649613/6d7a6ec3986673eb318bee8a8f21c1eefa292af1.png"][/img]
The good news is, as we shared on [url="https://x.com/BALLxPIT/status/1934312952779133397"]X[/url], we won’t be removing the demo after Steam Next Fest! So you can keep playing as much as you want until launch. AND we can also confirm that all your achievements and demo progress WILL carry over to the full release! (Sadly, it doesn’t work with Steam Deck…yet).

Also, we want you to know that much of your feedback and many of your suggestions will be reflected in the final game — in fact, some of them are! But, since the demo only includes the first level of the game, you cannot see them. But here is a little taste:
[/p][list][*][p] Passive fusions
[/p][/*][*][p] More ball and passive slots
[/p][/*][*][p] Higher starting levels of balls
[/p][/*][*][p] Number of minimum fusion upgrades
[/p][/*][*][p] And much more!!!
[/p][/*][/list][p]Now, if you’d like to stay connected with us, share your feedback, and be the first to hear news about BALL x PIT, we encourage you to [url="https://discord.gg/BALLxPIT"]join our Discord server[/url]. You can also follow us on [url="https://x.com/BALLxPIT"]X[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/ballxpit.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/BALLxPIT/"]Reddit[/url].

Thank you again for all the support, and see you in the pit, seekers! <3
[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.content: [p]Hi treasure seekers![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you're all enjoying BALL x PIT demo![/p][p]We're rolling out a small patch for the demo, so make sure to update the game before your next session.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Projectiles and player now use 3D colliders, so being hitboxes match visuals a bit better. There will still be a bit of leniency as the player's hitbox will be much narrower than the character. [/p][/*][*][p]Add setting to disable swirling background in fuser ui [/p][/*][*][p]Let boss crown flash even if 'reduce flashing colors' is enabled [/p][/*][*][p]Adjust freeze damage color to be less cyan [/p][/*][*][p]Increase/decrease game speed is now remappable on the keyboard [/p][/*][*][p]Various Bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's all for now! We encourage you to [url="https://discord.gg/BALLxPIT"]join our Discord[/url] server to report bugs, give feedback, and share suggestions with us.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p]

notes.title: Announcing BALL x PIT
notes.content:
[p]I'm excited to announce BALL x PIT, a ball bouncing, base building roguelite. I'm really bad at trying to explain what it is so here's the announcement video we premiered at Summer Game Fest.[/p][previewyoutube="AFDugjeJK5g;full"][/previewyoutube][p]There's currently a free demo available to play on Steam.[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3651790/BALL_x_PIT_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This year will mark a decade since my first commercial release and BALL x PIT feels like the culmination of everything I've done up to this point. I'm really proud of it, I think it will be one of the highlights of my career.[/p][p]This was my first time really leading a team, I'm lucky to have found some brilliant collaborators. Here's a list of the core team:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://x.com/VincentBini"]Sergio 'Bini' H. Alcelay[/url] (3D Artist) - Created all of the 3d models for the base building portion of the game (buildings, environment, elevator)[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/RaferLabarta"]Fernando Labarta Martin[/url] (Technical Artist) - Created all of the shaders and visual effects, including in-game balls, particles, etc.[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/atskaheart"]Mohammed Bakir Khawam[/url] (Low Poly Pixel Artist) - Crafted all of the pixel art textures and level environments[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://lisa-fasol.com/"]Lisa Fasol[/url] (Concept Artist) - Created concepts for the buildings, level environments, and enemies. They also created some of the pixel art for the prototype which I pitched to publishers, some of which is featured in the announcement video.[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://lukaparascandalo.com/"]Luka Parascandalo[/url] (Pixel Artist) - Created all of the icons and portraits in the game, along with most of the UI and some of the enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.amosroddy.com/"]Amos Roddy[/url] (Composer) - Composed on an amazing soundtrack for the game, some of which you can hear in the announcement video, plus a little sound design.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Devolver Digital is publishing it, who have been a dream to work with. The first indie game I ever purchased on Steam was Hotline Miami, exactly 12 years ago to the day (June 6th 2013), long before I ever thought I could do this for a living, so this feels like a real full circle moment. They've been hugely supportive of the game and have thrown a lot of their weight behind it, as evidenced by that unhinged video they put together for Summer Game Fest (which I love). [/p][p][/p][p]I'm hoping to write a few more posts about the development process of BALL x PIT as we get closer to launch, if I can find the time, but for now you can stay up to date through our official social channels and communities below.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649613/166a80cf3fe2b1f29b350b1db0926a389e7f3016.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649613/71b182e8cbeacbf17d3eb51ea247ef19296073e5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649613/b15f29672bf0e15d55244d015316a44609f49a8d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649613/d3a065b8767904f6633a115a8a5bca5f38e6e80b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649613/68c2d104c86fe61d00095ffdd32e4c1890dbd76c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]X: [url="https://x.com/ballxpit"]https://x.com/ballxpit[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bsky: [url="https://bsky.app/profile/ballxpit.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/ballxpit.bsky.social[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/BALLxPIT"]https://discord.gg/BALLxPIT[/url][/p][/*][*][p]TikTok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@ballxpit"]https://www.tiktok.com/@ballxpit[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Website: [url="https://www.ballxpit.com"]www.ballxpit.com[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Reddit: [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/BALLxPIT/"]https://www.reddit.com/r/BALLxPIT/[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
